moment.description: Launch Trailer 49-86s: dirt-bike rider frozen mid-air jumping an elevated train at golden hour (hook, frame 1) -> biplane with pink smoke over a packed Miami beach -> masked heist -> Lucia firing with explosion behind -> GTA VI logo + OUT NOW over the Vice City dusk skyline (end card).
moment.timestamp_note: hook frame = source second 49 (1fps frame f050); beach biplane = 55-56s; Lucia firing = 73s; OUT NOW skyline = 81-86s
moment.why_this_moment: Strongest launch-hype beat in either trailer, picked from 1fps contact sheets of both files (29 + 89 frames viewed): the rider mid-air over a train reads as GTA chaos in under a second at phone size, is centered so the 9:16 crop keeps him whole, and opens the clip on action instead of logos/black. The 37s arc then runs beauty (beach) -> heist -> explosions -> OUT NOW end card, so the clip ends on the launch message. The Out Now video was rejected as a source: mostly static end cards and club shots, no single action beat as strong as the jump.
